summary: Mocks from unittest.mock help with hard cases like simulating APIs but can make tests confusing; Ansible bundles mock as units.compat.mock.
questions: Which mock library should I import in Ansible unit tests?
When should I use mocks in module tests?

answer_card.title: Using mocks in module tests
answer_card.answer_md:
Mocks (`unittest.mock`) are useful for special cases, especially simulating an API, but overuse makes tests confusing. Import the bundled copy:
```python
import units.compat.mock
```
